decisions.reason: CPU half-precision Beta sampling raises native Dirichlet exceptions.
Incorrectly reduces float64 samplers to float32; 22 of 43 full-precision regression conditions differ from upstream base.
Conditional on fresh evaluator confirmation: all 88 conditions pass 1,710 semantic checks, including 43 exact full-precision base comparisons.
Diagnostic-only change leaves native CPU half-precision Beta sampling failures intact.
Half conversion corrupts beta before promotion: underflow, overflow and bfloat16 rounding violate concentration and seeded-draw requirements.
